_comment: Curated, real, geographically diverse flood/wetland-significant locations for VAMIKA's pre-seeded instant-demo cache (Tier 1). Coordinates are approximate region centers, not tied to any specific historical event date - the pre-seed script queries NASA CMR for whatever real NISAR acquisitions actually exist at each place and picks the best available real before/after pair. This list is version-controlled; backend/data/featured_cache.json (generated by the pre-seed script) holds the per-location analysis linkage and is NOT version-controlled. Mix of wetland and flood categories. More of the original 25 can be added back later (see git history).

locations.name: Pantanal
locations.blurb: The world's largest tropical wetland, spanning Brazil, Bolivia and Paraguay, with an extreme seasonal flood pulse that drives one of the planet's richest concentrations of wildlife.

locations.name: Okavango Delta
locations.blurb: A UNESCO World Heritage inland river delta in the Kalahari Desert that floods seasonally, supporting an exceptional concentration of wildlife in an otherwise arid region.

locations.name: Po River Delta
locations.blurb: The Mediterranean's largest wetland and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, at the mouth of Italy's longest river.

locations.name: Majuli Island (Brahmaputra)
locations.blurb: The world's largest river island, on the Brahmaputra in Assam, which loses significant land to annual monsoon flooding and erosion.

locations.name: Jakarta
locations.blurb: A megacity facing chronic monsoon and tidal flooding, worsened by rapid land subsidence.

locations.name: Indus River Floodplain (Sindh)
locations.blurb: The lower Indus floodplain, site of Pakistan's catastrophic 2022 floods that submerged roughly a third of the country at their peak.

locations.name: Venice Lagoon
locations.blurb: Venice's historic lagoon, increasingly affected by 'Acqua Alta' tidal flooding events.

locations.name: Houston / Texas Gulf Coast
locations.blurb: A major US metropolitan area catastrophically flooded by Hurricane Harvey's record rainfall in 2017.
